name: Uzzah
title: The Man Who Touched the Ark of the Covenant
summary: Uzzah was a son of Abinadab who helped transport the ark of the covenant from his father's house to Jerusalem during King David's reign. He was struck down by God when he reached out his hand and touched the ark to steady it after the oxen stumbled. His sudden death served as a solemn reminder of the holiness of God's things and the importance of following God's instructions.

keyEvents.title: The Ark Kept in Abinadab's House
keyEvents.description: The ark of the covenant had been kept in Abinadab's house at Kiriath-Jearim for many years after it was returned by the Philistines. Uzzah and his brother Ahio grew up near the ark.

keyEvents.title: Transporting the Ark on a New Cart
keyEvents.description: King David decided to move the ark of the covenant to Jerusalem, and Uzzah and Ahio drove the new cart on which the ark was placed. This went against God's command that the ark should be carried by the Levites.

keyEvents.title: Uzzah Touches the Ark
keyEvents.description: When they reached the threshing floor of Kidon, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out his hand and grabbed hold of God's ark to prevent it from falling.

keyEvents.title: God's Wrath and Uzzah's Death
keyEvents.description: The Lord was angry with Uzzah because of his irreverent act, and God struck him down there by the ark. Uzzah died on the spot beside the ark of God.

keyEvents.title: David Becomes Afraid and Angry
keyEvents.description: That day David was both angry and afraid of the Lord. He named the place Perez-Uzzah, which means 'Uzzah's breach,' and he did not dare to move the ark further to the City of David.

keyEvents.title: The Ark Is Placed with Obed-Edom
keyEvents.description: After Uzzah's death, the ark was instead placed in the house of Obed-Edom from Gath, where it remained for three months. The Lord blessed Obed-Edom and his entire household while the ark was there.
